Indian Coast Guard CGEPT 01/2027 & 02/2027 Online Form – Full Details

Join Indian Coast Guard has released the notification for the post of Navik GD & Yantrik 01/2027 & 02/2027 Batch. This recruitment has been issued for 365 posts. The online application process for Indian Coast Guard CGEPT 01/2027 & 02/2027 Recruitment has started on 06 October 2026, and candidates can apply till 21 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Indian Coast Guard CGEPT 01/2027 & 02/2027 Recruitment which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 06 October 2026
  • Last Date : 21 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 21 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • All Candidates (Other than SC / ST) : Rs. 550/-
  • SC, ST : No Fee

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
